frontmatter.name: israeli-accessibility-compliance
frontmatter.description: Implement Israeli web accessibility compliance per IS 5568 standard, anchored to WCAG 2.0 AA (IS 5568 adds some 2.1-aligned criteria; sources differ), for Hebrew RTL applications. Use when user asks about Israeli accessibility law, "negishot" (accessibility), IS 5568, "teken negishot" (accessibility standard), "nachim" (disabilities), Hebrew screen reader support, RTL ARIA patterns, or accessibility audit for Israeli websites. Covers mandatory legal requirements under the Equal
frontmatter.compatibility: Works with any web framework. Python 3.9+ for audit script. No network required for core patterns. axe-core for automated testing.
